rules.title: Composition API
rules.text: Use the Composition API with <script setup> and TypeScript.

rules.title: Typed props and emits
rules.text: Declare typed props and emits with defineProps and defineEmits.

rules.title: Pinia for shared state
rules.text: Use Pinia for shared state; keep local state in components.

rules.title: Keys on v-for
rules.text: Always provide a stable :key with v-for and never combine v-if with v-for.
